result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I checked that the module compiles, but I didn't run any tests, and I didn't add one for this case.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

Blank latest-commit dates already count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for a blank date. Nobody is dropped for missing data. Configured teams still keep all their members, active or not.
